prompt: Create an original top-down overhead vehicle reference sheet for a cozy cyberpunk Game Boy game called Dialtone. Plain light background, lots of spacing, no text, no labels, no rider characters, no shadows covering the forms.

palette: strict grayscale only, light background, dark outlines, very limited tones
constraints: must be easy to trace into tiny Game Boy sprites, no texture noise, no perspective, no text, no extra objects
